beats.say: This animal almost always gives birth to identical quadruplets.
The nine-banded armadillo. Wrapped in bony armor.
Every litter, four babies. Identical, and all the same sex.
And when it's scared, it jumps straight up. Three to four feet in the air.
But that jump doesn't help against cars. That's why so many end up on roadsides.
And no, it can't roll up into a ball.
Its nose can smell food through eight inches of dirt.
It digs with a long claw, for ants, termites, grubs, and worms.
It comes out at night, and forages from dusk till dawn.
It can hold its breath for up to six minutes.
To swim, it puffs up its own guts with air. Or it sinks, and walks along the bottom.
Now the scary part. It can carry the germ that causes leprosy.
Wild armadillos have passed leprosy to people. So don't pick one up.
Armor plating, four identical babies, and it still loses to a pickup truck.
